translations.answer: The balance strategy will still search for recovery actions under the assumption of grounded support, and may drive leg movement if the feet are not in contact with the ground. The gantry should remain in place for fall prevention, but the feet must actually touch the ground and have appropriate slack before entering the balance/walk policy.
translations.applicability: Applicable to initial calibration and balance strategy testing of G1 EDU.
translations.credibility.rationale: The environment, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: Maintain the gantry but ensure feet are grounded before activating balance.
translations.details.attempts.1: Stop the task, fix the gantry, return to idle, and cool down externally before investigating the root cause.
translations.details.attempts.2: Keep the vendor image, install the SDK as per official documentation.
translations.details.attempts.3: Compile and run a read-only state example.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Check status, alerts, temperature, network, and calibration in the Explore App.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: SSH post to check interfaces and SDK2 example, read status before writing control.
translations.details.environments.0: Unitree G1 EDU; onboard Jetson development computing unit; SDK2 expects Ubuntu 20.04, GCC 9.4, CMake 3.10+.
translations.details.limits.0: The post is a summary of personal experience; external fans are only emergency measures and cannot replace thermal source or load diagnosis.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The author provides a safe and debugging sequence but does not provide temperature curves or independent replication experiments.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why do the legs move violently when the G1 is suspended in the gantry and entering balance/walk mode?
translations.details.problem_statements.1: What is the safe procedure when a joint overheats during operation?
translations.details.problem_statements.2: Why should the onboard Jetson not be arbitrarily re-flashed?
translations.details.problem_statements.3: What is the minimum test that should be run first when integrating SDK2?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Always retain the gantry, clear the area, establish an emergency stop path, and use low-risk initial poses; control examples must be validated in the read-only state chain before gradually releasing them.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The support/contact assumption in the balance strategy is invalid.
translations.details.suspected_causes.1: Continuous motion leads to localized motor thermal accumulation.
translations.details.suspected_causes.2: The Jetson image and robot internal software stack are out of sync.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The balance strategy continues to search for support and drive legs even when the feet are not grounded.
translations.details.symptoms.1: An audible overheating alert is heard during remote operation or policy execution.
translations.details.symptoms.2: When the SDK example fails, it is difficult to distinguish between network, DDS, and code issues.
translations.media_summaries.0: All key content of the X Article is in the visible main text; the images mainly showcase the G1 body and protection, and do not serve as log or parameter evidence.
translations.source.title: Order of Calibration, Safety, Jetson, and SDK2 Integration for Unitree G1 Initial On-Site
translations.title: Why can't the G1 directly enter balance or walk mode when suspended in the gantry and feet are off the ground?
